campusCover.heroTitle: Nurturing Islamic Scholarship & Modern Academic Brilliance
campusCover.heroSubtitle: A serene coastal campus in Nandi, Kerala dedicated to producing ethical leaders, scholars, and professionals.
campusCover.heroDescription: Darussalam Academy harmoniously unites classical Islamic disciplines, Hifz-ul-Quran, and modern school education in a disciplined, uplifting environment.
campusCover.campusLocation: Nandi Beach Road, Kozhikode District, Kerala

aboutUs.history: Founded in 1998 under the visionary leadership of distinguished Kerala Islamic scholars, Darussalam Academy has stood as a beacon of moral and educational reformation on the serene Malabar coast.
aboutUs.mission: To cultivate righteous individuals grounded in sound Islamic theology, intellectual curiosity, high academic competence, and civic responsibility.
aboutUs.vision: To be a premier center of integrated learning where tradition and modernity inspire visionary community leadership.
aboutUs.heritageParagraph: Situated in Nandi, Kozhikode, surrounded by breezy palm canopies and the Arabian sea breeze, our campus offers a distraction-free, spiritually elevating atmosphere where students memorize the Holy Quran, master Arabic and jurisprudence, and excel in modern sciences.
facilities: Grand Central Juma Masjid & Prayer Halls
Clean Boarding Hostels & Hygienic Malabar Mess

contactUs.addressLine2: Near Nandi Railway Station, Koyilandy Taluk

programs.title: Da'wa & Shari'ah Integrated Degree
programs.description: An intensive curriculum weaving classical Usul al-Fiqh, Hadith studies, Arabic rhetoric, and modern bachelor degree programs.

programs.title: Hifz-ul-Quran with Regular Schooling
programs.description: Carefully calibrated Tajweed and daily Quranic memorization alongside state curriculum mathematics, science, English, and Malayalam.

programs.title: Senior Secondary (Kerala State / NIOS)
programs.description: Rigorous academic coaching for board examinations coupled with moral ethics, personality development, and competitive entrance coaching.

programs.title: Primary & Upper Primary Wing
programs.description: Holistic child development fostering Islamic manners (Adab), fluent reading of Arabic & English, mental math, and experiential curiosity.

achievements.description: Recognized by Kozhikode District Environmental Forum for sustainable rainwater harvesting and solar adoption.
